was: City of Atlantic park in a reclaimed quarry with 3 lakes; ~20 sites (expanding), full hookups, shower house, restrooms, dog park. Reservable online via Campspot. Open year-round. RV Life 4.5 star / price 2. --Claude
note: City of Atlantic park in a reclaimed quarry with three lakes, with restrooms and a dog park. --Claude

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/park/schildberg-recreation-area-campground (35 Standard Full Hookup RV Sites available for 2026-11-10, its only type; the note's '~20 sites (expanding)' was older), read 2026-10-13

was: Pepin County park on 97-acre Silver Birch Lake just south of Arkansaw (N5362 County Rd N). 20 sites with 30-amp electric (1-16 standard $20, 17-20 premium $25), pit toilets, non-potable water, boat ramp. Reservable online via Campspot; open mid-April-November. (RV Life unrated). --Claude
note: Pepin County park on 97-acre Silver Birch Lake just south of Arkansaw (N5362 County Rd N), with a boat ramp: sites 1-16 are standard and 17-20 premium.  Open mid-April through November.  Not rated on RV Life. --Claude

was: Operated by the Town of Sand Creek (NOT private — RV Life mis-tags it commercial), on the Red Cedar River 3 mi N of Sand Creek. 54 sites, 28 electric; showers, flush toilets, dump station, WiFi, boat landing (small craft). Open May 15-Oct 15. Reservable via Campspot, $30/night. --Claude
note: Town of Sand Creek park on the Red Cedar River, 3 miles north of Sand Creek, with a small-craft boat landing; 28 of the sites have electric.  RV Life lists it as commercial, but the town runs it. --Claude

was: Private family campground at 2498 E Hubert Rd, Spruce; ~36 grassy sites with 30-amp full and W/E hookups (back-in and pull-thru) plus tent sites. Pool, clubhouse, store; reservable online via Campspot. Off US-23 ~15 min from Alpena, near Lake Huron's BeeBee Beach and across from Thunder Bay River State Forest (no on-site water). RV Life 4.5*/2$ (auto 6/2026). --Claude
note: Family campground at 2498 E Hubert Rd, Spruce, off US-23 about 15 minutes from Alpena: grassy sites with electric only, water and electric, or full hookups, plus tent sites, a pool and a clubhouse.  Near Lake Huron's BeeBee Beach and across the road from Thunder Bay River State Forest. --Claude

was: Campground and day-use area on the shore of Lake Guntersville near Grant; ~130 sites (most water/electric, some waterfront), swim beach, boat rentals, bathhouses, store, dump station. 2-night minimum on every site, not just the rentals. --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on every site (Campspot, an October weeknight, 2026-10-12). --Claude
note: Campground and day-use area on Lake Guntersville near Grant, with a swim beach and boat rentals; most sites have water and electric. --Claude

was: Full-service RV park on 40 acres at 10050 E FM 1462, Alvin (opened 2020); full hookups, gated with cameras, laundry/showers/dump, on-site fishing ponds; RV and tent sites, bookable nightly via Campspot. Highly rated (RV Life 10/10; 4.8 Google). RV Life 5*/$$ (auto 7/2026). --Claude
note: RV park on 40 acres at 10050 E FM 1462, Alvin, opened in 2020: gated, with security cameras, fishing ponds and tent sites too.  Rated 4.8 on Google. --Claude

was: Cattaraugus County marina park on the Allegheny Reservoir (Kinzua) north of the Pennsylvania line. 71 sites with water and 30-amp electric; showers, laundry, dump station. About two thirds are seasonal - 23 transient sites book on Campspot, with a 3-night minimum in July, August and holidays. --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 3 nights in July, August and on holidays (onoville.com rules, 2026-10-12). --Claude
note: Cattaraugus County marina park on the Allegheny Reservoir (Kinzua), just north of the Pennsylvania line.  About two-thirds of the sites are seasonal; the 23 transient sites are the ones that book online. --Claude

was: Crittenden County park at the old Ohio River Lock and Dam 50 near Marion. Seven full-hookup RV sites looking out over the river, plus primitive camping; boat ramp. Book on Campspot; 14-night limit. Small and remote - no store nearby. --Claude
note: Crittenden County park at the old Ohio River Lock and Dam 50 near Marion, with primitive camping beside the RV sites and a boat ramp.  Small and remote, with no store nearby. --Claude

was: City of Colona campground off I-80/I-74 east of the Quad Cities. About 195 water/electric (30/50 amp) sites, some full hookup and 40 pull-throughs for big rigs; pool, mini golf, fishing ponds, showers, laundry. Open year-round; book on Campspot. --Claude
note: City of Colona campground off I-80/I-74 east of the Quad Cities, with a pool, mini golf and fishing ponds; some sites have full hookups, and about 40 pull-throughs suit big rigs.  The city also rents sites for the whole season. --Claude

season.source: https://www.colonail.com/scottpark ('Season starts May 1st and ends October 31st'; 2026 Rules & Regulations, version 1.7, updated 5/4/2026), read 2026-10-13

was: Trempealeau County park on the Trempealeau River between Arcadia and Independence. 19 water/electric and 16 electric grass sites, showers, trails. Book on Campspot. --Claude
note: Trempealeau County park on the Trempealeau River between Arcadia and Independence, with trails: 19 water/electric and 16 electric-only grass sites. --Claude

was: City of Evart park on the Muskegon River with a riverside trail, splash pad and canoe access. 15 water/electric sites, dump station, restrooms. May 1 to September 30; book on Campspot. --Claude
note: City of Evart park on the Muskegon River with a riverside trail, a splash pad, canoe access and restrooms; its sites have 30-amp electric. --Claude

was: 54-site campground on the Pine River (Blue Ribbon trout stream, canoe landing) inside the Manistee National Forest near Wellston; electric/water, electric-only and rustic sites, cabins, trailer and pop-up rentals, fishing ponds. Family rate (2 adults, 2 kids, 1 RV) May 20-Sep 10: E/W $50, electric $45, rustic $35 (lower shoulder season). Unrated on RV Life; Campspot 4.8 over 32 verified reviews. --Claude
note: Campground with a canoe landing on the Pine River, a Blue Ribbon trout stream, inside the Manistee National Forest near Wellston: water/electric, electric-only and rustic sites, cabins, trailer and pop-up rentals, and fishing ponds.  A site's price covers a family of 2 adults and 2 children with one RV.  Not rated on RV Life; Campspot reviewers give it 4.8 (32 reviews). --Claude

was: Campground and cabins at 13723 Main St in the old sawmill town of Nahma, built on the mill slips opening onto Big Bay de Noc (Lake Michigan) beside the Sturgeon River mouth; ~50 electric (30A) RV sites along the slips plus water/electric RV sites, boat ramp, rentals, laundry, showers, dump station. Founded 1997 as No-Nah-Ma Resort; sold in 2025 (Iron Mountain Daily News) and now books on Campspot as Nahma Lakeside Landing Campground and Lodging LLC. Campspot June 2027 weeknight: W/E RV site $35. Seasonal May-Oct. No operator site found beyond Campspot. Not on RV Life; Campspot 4.8 over 34 verified reviews. --Claude
note: Campground and cabins at 13723 Main St in the old sawmill town of Nahma, built on the mill slips that open onto Big Bay de Noc (Lake Michigan) beside the mouth of the Sturgeon River: about 50 30-amp electric sites along the slips plus water/electric sites, a boat ramp and rentals.  Open May to October.  Founded in 1997 as No-Nah-Ma Resort and sold in 2025 (Iron Mountain Daily News); it has no website of its own and books through Campspot as Nahma Lakeside Landing Campground and Lodging LLC.  Not listed on RV Life; Campspot reviewers give it 4.8 (34 reviews). --Claude

was: Campground with a bar and grill and canoe/kayak/tube rentals on the Upper Iowa River at Bluffton, northwest of Decorah: about 59 RV sites, 30/50-amp electric and a few full hookups, season May 1 - Oct 31. Campspot booking; 30-amp sites $48 on an October 2026 weeknight. Owns White's Riverside across the river (now 'Kenny's Corner'). --Claude
note: Campground with a bar and grill and canoe, kayak and tube rentals on the Upper Iowa River at Bluffton, northwest of Decorah; only a few sites have full hookups.  The same owners run White's Riverside across the river (now 'Kenny's Corner'). --Claude

was: Campground and canoe outfitter at Caplinger Mills (6647 S 1451 Rd, Stockton): water/electric 30/50-amp sites $45 a night, $40 Sunday-Thursday; primitive and electric tent sites, cabins, yurt, float trips. Online booking (Campspot). Also listed as Caplinger Mills RV Park. --Claude
note: Campground and canoe outfitter at Caplinger Mills (6647 S 1451 Rd, Stockton) with float trips, primitive and electric tent sites, cabins and a yurt.  Also listed as Caplinger Mills RV Park. --Claude

was: Campground north of Salem near Jadwin (12099 State Hwy K): standard back-in RV sites from $35 a night, $230 a week, $700 a month; tent sites and a group site. Online booking (Campspot). --Claude
note: Campground north of Salem near Jadwin (12099 State Hwy K) with back-in and pull-through RV sites, tent sites and a group site; back-in sites also rent by the week ($230) and month ($700). --Claude

was: Small campground near Jameson (18515 MO-13): RV sites $45 a night (weekdays 10% off), $265 a week; tent sites, Amish bunkhouses, restroom and shower house. Online booking (Campspot). --Claude
note: Small campground near Jameson (18515 MO-13): 12 gravel back-in RV pads 35-42 ft long and one wide pad without hookups, plus tent sites and Amish-built bunkhouses.  The park's own page lists weekly ($265) and monthly ($629) rates. --Claude

hookups.source: https://honeygrovecampground.com/ ('All the RV Sites have both 30 and 50 AMP electric plugs and water hookups'; the one wide pad has none), read 2026-10-13

was: Small RV park in Versailles (506 N Walnut Ave): limited-hookup back-in sites (30/50-amp and water) $28 a night, full-hookup pull-throughs. RVs must be 2015 or newer - call for older rigs. Online booking (Campspot). --Claude
note: Small RV park in Versailles (506 N Walnut Ave): full-hookup back-ins and pull-throughs, and a limited-hookup back-in (30/50-amp and water).  RVs must be 2015 or newer; call about older rigs. --Claude

booking.note: Campspot asks 2 nights for both full-hookup site types on weeknights from October to December 2026; the one limited-hookup back-in (25 ft) sells single nights.

booking.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/rock-island (RESERVATION_MIN_RULE 'There is a 2 night minimum' on both full-hookup types for one night from 2026-10-21, 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-08; none on the limited-hookup back-in), read 2026-10-13

was: Good Sam park at 1037 Austin Rd, Sparta, on the western edge of the Cumberland Plateau: concrete-pad back-in full-hookup sites (30/50 amp) from about $50 a night, pricier premium sites too. Online booking (Campspot). --Claude
note: Good Sam park at 1037 Austin Rd, Sparta, on the western edge of the Cumberland Plateau, with concrete pads, back-in and pull-through. --Claude

was: Good Sam park at 3420 US-65 south of Pine Bluff: concrete-slab full-hookup back-in sites (20/30/50 amp, Wi-Fi) from $48.50 a night; bathhouse, laundromat, dog park, fitness center and clubhouse. Online booking (Campspot). --Claude
note: Good Sam park at 3420 US-65 south of Pine Bluff, with concrete slabs (back-in and pull-through), a bathhouse, dog park, fitness center and clubhouse. --Claude

was: Lot-ownership RV resort off Summerlin Rd near the Fort Myers Beach causeway, renting owners' sites nightly. 2026 daily rates (pre-tax): standard $117.60 Dec-Mar, $85.05 Nov and Apr, $83.35 May-Oct; lakefront and luxury tiers up to $164. Travel trailers allowed only May-Oct; RVs are inspected for type/length/age/condition at check-in. --Claude
note: Lot-ownership RV resort off Summerlin Rd near the Fort Myers Beach causeway that rents owners' sites by the night.  Travel trailers only May to October, and an RV that doesn't match its booking (type, length, age, condition) can be turned away at check-in without a refund. --Claude

was: All-ages Sun Outdoors RV resort on US-41 (S Tamiami Trl), south Fort Myers, around two ponds. Single nights bookable on Campspot (early-winter 2027 quote): standard full-hookup back-in $113, deluxe concrete or paver $121, premium pull-through $138.45; all sites take rigs to 45 ft. Pond-front sites carry a 28-night minimum in winter. --Claude
note: All-ages Sun Outdoors RV resort on US-41 (S Tamiami Trl) in south Fort Myers, set around two ponds.  Pond-front sites take a 28-night minimum in winter. --Claude

was: Forested campground at 7063 Tillicum Rd outside Vernon, a short walk from BX Falls and the BX Trail: 56 numbered sites, about 29 of them RV sites (15A, 15A + water, 30A, 30A + water and a few full hookups; many for rigs to 40 ft), plus tent sites and a cabin; washrooms and showers cleaned daily, laundry; some long-term pads. A Tuesday July 2027 night sells online at C$45 (15A + water), C$52 (30A + water), C$40 unserviced, before tax. Booked online (Campspot). --Claude
note: Forested campground at 7063 Tillicum Rd outside Vernon, a short walk from BX Falls and the BX Trail: about 29 RV sites (15-amp, 15-amp with water, 30-amp, 30-amp with water and a few full hookups; many take rigs to 40 ft), plus tent sites, a cabin and some long-term pads. --Claude

was: Campground at 423 Hwy 6, Cherryville, between Vernon/Lumby and the Arrow Lakes, beside Cherry Creek: about 45 RV sites - dry, 15A, 30A, 30A + water and 30A full-hookup back-ins and pull-throughs for rigs to 55-60 ft - plus tent and hike-in sites, cabins, trails and RV storage; dry camping in fall and winter. A Tuesday July 2027 night sells online at C$49.55 (15A), C$51.45 (30A), C$54.30 (30A + water), C$56.20 (full hookup), before tax. Booked online (Campspot). Caveat (2026): the full-hookup septic was noted as temporarily unavailable. --Claude
note: Campground at 423 Hwy 6, Cherryville, beside Cherry Creek between Vernon/Lumby and the Arrow Lakes: about 45 RV sites (dry, 15-amp, 30-amp, 30-amp with water and 30-amp full hookup) for rigs to 55-60 ft, plus tent and hike-in sites, cabins, trails and RV storage.  Dry camping in fall and winter.  In October 2026 Campspot listed the septic at full-hookup sites 00-10 as temporarily unavailable. --Claude
